section.notesPlaceholder: Internal notes about this client — auto-saved
section.dangerHelper: Permanently removes from this workspace. Disconnects from all linked projects.

billing.typeTip: Business → tax invoice; individual → cash receipt.
billing.helper: Auto-fills tax invoice / cash receipt details when issuing invoices. Also saved here when the customer enters it on the invoice.

inviteModal.title: Invite Client
inviteModal.name: Name
inviteModal.helper: If the email matches an existing user, they'll be added as a client to this workspace. Otherwise a new account will be auto-created and an invite sent (later).
inviteModal.emailFailed: The invite was created but the email couldn’t be sent. Check mail settings and use “Resend invite”.

deleteModal.title: Confirm client deletion
deleteModal.body: will be removed from this workspace permanently.
deleteModal.noImpact: No other project links — disappears from this workspace after deletion.
deleteModal.caveat: The user account itself (login) is preserved. You can re-invite anytime.

invitePending.title: Invitation pending
invitePending.desc: They haven't signed up yet. Resend the email if they didn't receive it.
invitePending.resendConfirmBody: Another invitation email will go to {{email}}. Sent email cannot be recalled.
invitePending.noEmail: No address to send to — add an email to this client
invitePending.resendFailed: Couldn't resend. Please try again shortly.

subscription.title: Recurring subscription
subscription.vatNote: 10% VAT is added automatically when billed.
subscription.empty: No recurring subscriptions yet. Use "Start subscription" to set up monthly/weekly auto-billing.
subscription.cancelBody: Automatic billing stops after canceling. Invoices already issued stay. This cannot be undone.
subscription.billBodyAuto: An invoice is created and the billing email is sent right away to {{to}}.
subscription.billBodyDraft: An invoice is created as a draft. Review it in Q bill and send it from there (no email goes to the client yet).
subscription.noRecipient: Auto-send is on but there is no recipient — add a tax invoice or billing contact email under business details.
subscription.errOwnerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change subscriptions.
subscription.errAction: Could not complete this. Please try again shortly.

timeline.title: Customer Timeline
timeline.error: Couldn't load the timeline. Please try again shortly.
timeline.emptyDesc: Chats, emails, tasks, and invoices with this customer will appear here in order.

emptyDesc: A client opens a conversation, and tasks and billing follow from there.

addModal.modeInviteHelp: Sends an invite email. Once they sign up, the client sees chats, files and invoices themselves.
addModal.modeManagedHelp: No email is sent. A client you keep and manage yourselves (no account) — for invoices, projects and receipts. You can invite them any time later.
addModal.errNameOrCompany: Enter a name or a company
addModal.errExists: A client with the same email or phone already exists.
addModal.errAlreadyMember: This email belongs to a member of this workspace — add them as a project member instead of a client.
addModal.errLinkProject: The client was created but could not be added to the project. Add it again from "Link existing client".
addModal.inviteConfirmBody: An invitation email will be sent to {{email}}. A sent email cannot be taken back.
addModal.errAlreadyClient: This mail is already linked to another client.
addModal.linkThisMail: Link this mail to that client
addModal.errLinkMail: Could not link the mail to that client.
addModal.sourceMail: Saving links this mail, and mail from the same address, to this client.
addModal.sourceChat: Saving links this chat to this client.
addModal.relayUseManual: This inquiry came through a web form, so the sender is not a person. Enter the name and contact written in the message.

managed.title: Managed client
managed.desc: Details only, no account. Use them for invoices, projects and receipts. Invite them if the client should log in and see things directly.
managed.contactHelper: This client has no account, so you edit these here. The email is locked once an invite is sent.

archivedBanner.title: Archived client
archivedBanner.desc: Hidden from the default list. Records and links stay as they are.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.helper: Other people at this client — save their card details and their emails will attach to this client.
contacts.deleteMsg: This removes {{name}}'s contact details. This can't be undone.
